name: Equity momentum gated by calm credit spreads (long)
rationale: EQUITY SEGMENT (asset_classes=[equity]) + REGIME-SWITCHING — distinct asset class for diversity and a credit-regime switch the crypto specs cannot use (credit_spread is equity-only). Credit spreads are the bond market's real-time read on default/stress risk and lead equity drawdowns: equity trend-following pays in benign-credit regimes and gets whipsawed when spreads blow out (a credit event drags equities down regardless of price momentum). This gates an EQUITY momentum long by the credit regime: long when equity ret is positive AND credit_spread is below a fitted calm ceiling (no stress); exit when momentum fades or spreads widen through an exit level (credit regime broke). Distinct from every crypto spec and from the existing equity TAA arms (DAA/VAA/sector-rotation — those are monthly allocation models, not a credit-gated momentum trigger). It judges on the deploy/gate lane like other equity specs. Disconfirmer 1: drop the credit gate — if bare equity momentum matches the deflated Sharpe, the credit regime adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: credit_spread is slow (next-day FRED); if it is near-constant over the sample it is not selecting regimes. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): credit_spread is daily next-day-available; net of equity round-trip costs the gated momentum must clear. tier0 credit_spread + tier0 ret_Nd (equity), credit_spread has prod data — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: positive equity momentum WHILE credit spreads are calm (no bond-market stress) — credit-regime-gated equity trend
